## What changed

- Fixed README screenshots not appearing in the HACS repository view.
- Replaced HTML image elements with standard Markdown image syntax, allowing HACS to resolve each image against the correct repository release.
- Kept the complete-card, tank-only, details-only, and graphical-editor screenshots in the README.
- Fixed the license badge link so HACS no longer corrupts its image URL while rewriting relative repository links.
- Changed the release workflow to publish these version-specific notes when the release is created, so HACS receives the full announcement immediately instead of an autogenerated changelog.
- Added a release check that stops publication when the version-specific notes file is missing.
- No SaltWatch Card rendering, configuration, or dashboard behavior changed in this release.

## Compatibility

No configuration changes are required. Existing cards update in place through HACS.

## Validation

- Verified the README uses the Markdown image form handled by HACS's repository-aware renderer.
- Verified the HACS rewrite produces exactly four release-pinned screenshot URLs and leaves the license badge intact.
- Verified all four referenced image files exist in the tagged repository.
- Verified release publication requires and consumes the v0.4.19 notes file.
- 30 unit tests passed.
- 33 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- Production build, HACS validation, and GitHub release workflow passed.
